_comment: ── verify-command 判据的【规则表】（t53）────────────────────────────────【这里放的是表，不是逻辑】。判据每次调用时读它 ⇒ 改这个文件**不需要重载插件**（改 .ts 才需要）。★ 判据本身只保留「怎么用这些表」，所以这个文件里【不许】出现任何判定逻辑 —— 一个能表达逻辑的数据文件会变成不可测的解释器。
_constantExit: ── 事实一：以这些命令起头的命令，退出码【不取决于任务产出】──────

constantGreenCommands.name: true
constantGreenCommands.why: exits 0 no matter what the task produced

constantRedCommands.name: false
constantRedCommands.why: exits non-zero no matter what the task produced

_aliases: ── `:` 是 POSIX 的空命令（恒绿）；`!false` 是 `false` 的取反（也恒绿）。它们与 true/false 是【同一类事实】的别名。
_assertionCommands: ── 事实二：这些命令【本可以断言】，但在某几个形状下断言不了 ──────────

assertionCommands.name: test
assertionCommands.why: a bare operand asserts the literal, not the work
same as test, with the closing bracket as syntax

_negationExclusion: ── ★ 刻意【不是】恒真的一张表（它的存在就是这条规则的一部分）──────────

notConstantDespiteShape.why: MEASURED: this repository really uses `! grep -qiE "rollback" file.md` (a check that a word must NOT appear). It is perfectly judgeable — red when the word is there, green when it is not. Treating it as constant-green would be a FALSE POSITIVE, and a gate that cries wolf gets ignored.

_processSubstitution: ── 事实三：这一族命令的成败可能取决于另一个命令的输出 ──────────────────

processSubstitutionReaders.name: grep
processSubstitutionReaders.why: may be comparing against the output of a nested command

_wholeLineSwitch: ── 整行匹配的开关：只有它们会让「命令输出的空白」决定成败 ────────────
_wholeLineShortPatternNote: ── 短选项形状也在这里（一个正则源码字符串）⇒ 改它同样不必重载 ────
